info.name: ELK Backend
info.description:
Every HTTP endpoint in the ELK backend, grouped by module.

Setup:
1. Import the companion "ELK Backend — Local" environment and select it.
2. `docker compose up -d && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma db seed && npm run start:dev`.
3. Run Auth → "1. Request OTP", read the 4-digit code from the API server console, put it in the {{otp}} variable, then run "2. Verify OTP" — the access token is saved automatically.

All routes are versioned under /api/v1 except the health probes. Requests marked [ADMIN] / [PROVIDER] need that role on your user.
List requests store the first row id into an environment variable, so folders can be run top to bottom.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Phone/OTP login. Run 1 → 2 in order; the token is stored automatically.

console.log('No SMS provider is wired: the 4-digit code is printed in the API server console as "OTP for <phone>: 1234". Copy it into the {{otp}} environment variable, then run "2. Verify OTP".');

if (pm.response.code === 200) {
